name: fhir-normalizer
description: Transforms raw, heterogeneous wearable sensor data payloads (heart rate, HRV, step count) into compliant HL7 FHIR R4 Observation resources.
instructions: 1. Extract sensor metrics from incoming JSON payload.
2. Map metrics to standard FHIR R4 Observation structures.
3. Add proper coding systems (e.g., LOINC) for observations.
4. Ensure user reference is present and valid.
constraints: Do not alter established FHIR resource keys. Reject payloads missing a valid user reference.
